properties.name: The 44 REALIZES edges that pointed at changes, requirements, checks and findings are replaced by the edge each should have been
properties.rationale: Corrected at the cause of each edge, per dec:realizes-is-restricted-to-capability-component-and-interface: every one is re-expressed as the relation it actually meant, so no link is lost. The design's KNOWLEDGE changed, not the system — subject: record. The schema restriction that stops the class recurring follows in the same PR.
properties.subject: record
properties.summary:
Replacements written before any removal: 12 CHANGED (change → the file it touched, where none existed), 2 DOCUMENTS (field-report document → its finding), 6 IMPLEMENTS (test file → its check: 4 new checks, 2 existing ones that nothing implemented), 2 VERIFIES (those existing checks → the requirement), 1 REALIZES re-pointed (vocabulary-reach baseline → cap:the-design-says-what-its-own-tools-cannot-write). Then the 44 wrong REALIZES edges removed: 29 on ChangeEvents, 7 on Requirements, 6 on Verifications, 2 on TemporalFacts.

ADDED AFTER CI CAUGHT IT: removing the 44 left 5 files attached to nothing (self_host_uses_documents). Each got its true edge: check_doc_versions.py REALIZES cap:a-cut-moves-every-version-claim-together; the taxonomy command REALIZES cap:establish-taxonomy-before-bulk-capture; tests/provenance.rs IMPLEMENTS ver:stamp; upgrading-to-v0.55.0.md DOCUMENTS dec:qualitygate-is-retired-…; the_compliance_layer_is_whole.rs IMPLEMENTS a new ver:the-compliance-layer-is-whole that VERIFIES cmp:operate (the layer has no requirement or capability — recorded as a finding).
